opportunities.title: Henry Moore Grants – Autumn 2026 Round
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Non‑profit organisations (UK and international) can apply for New Projects and Commissions, Acquisitions and Collections, Conferences, Lectures and Publications, and Long‑Term Research grants. Individuals (sculpture historians, academics, conservators) can apply for Research and Travel grants.
opportunities.summary: Funding for sculpture projects including exhibitions, commissions, acquisitions, conservation, research, publications and conferences.
